title: Sociedad y poder
goal: Read how religion and power worked in Mexica and Inca society, and talk about how each organised authority.

items: Explain why the Sapa Inca's authority was seen as religious, not just political.
Explain what the Mexica believed human sacrifice did for the Fifth Sun.
Explain how the Sapa Inca ruled through reciprocity and redistribution with the curacas of each ayllu.
Contrast how the Mexica and Inca organised power, with tribute from subject cities versus reciprocity.
Use se pasiva to describe how an institution worked.
